label: Ashcombe, 1923
summary: A seaside country house in the summer of 1923, full of guests, gossip and closed doors.

world.setting: Ashcombe House, a country estate above a seaside village in England
world.description: A rambling house with too many guest rooms, a walled garden, a tennis lawn nobody mows straight, and a village below where the post office knows everyone's business. The family has invited half the county for the summer.
rules: Historical and realistic: no magic or supernatural events
Manners and reputation matter; secrets are currency
Romance develops slowly and only with mutual interest
